name: baccarat-evolution-full-width-full-length
label: Evolution — Full Width / Full Length
captureTarget: The whole casino window: table, betting area and result strip.
ocrUse: Reads Banker/Player/Tie and, if you enable it, card values.
notes: Safest starting point, and the slowest to read. Prefer a tighter region once you have calibrated. Evolution's card display sits higher; the result strip is usually narrower. Run calibration with your casino window open before enabling OCR; this region is a starting point, not a measurement.
